neighbours.label: Holding a post for a time: 'a position he held until', 'a role he served', French 'un poste qu'il occupe'; a plain record or plain appointment stays low.
fire: In 1802 he became vicar at Oxford, a position which he held for life.
She was named dean at Yale, a position she held until 1931.
He took on the job of treasurer, a role he served until his retirement.
Il est nommé directeur, un poste qu'il occupe jusqu'en 1960.
In 1950 she became head of the lab, a post she held for years.

She joined as chief editor, a position she kept until her death.
